material_boundaries.method: All material boundary endpoints/midpoints to exact line segments; no source/native vertex-index matching
material_boundaries.seam_method: Within-model bind-coincident records shared by different materials; virtual grouping at 1e-7 reference height
limitations: Texture-name matching is evidence for comparison, not proof of identical rendering semantics
Intentional LOD changes, overlays and changed texture atlases require human review
Boundary sampling does not certify interior geometry or all real game animation poses

static_metrics.distance_method: Deterministic area-weighted bidirectional triangle-surface distance; no vertex-index matching

review_findings.evidence: The 84 successfully audited uppercase .PAC native references contained skinned palettes of 3–8 slots; their three 1-slot meshes were rigid 0x11ff.
review_findings.interpretation: Observed convention only. Generic PSP GE support does not establish SVR loader compatibility. This is not a proven cause or a mandatory minimum.

analytical_validation.limitation: Serialization/LBS consistency only; not original SYM or actual PSP clip equivalence

format_checks: PASS: native offsets/ranges/palettes/weights/relocations, GIMs, base skeleton and unrelated target sections
known_limits: Main-model-only trial; source accessory-state semantics not converted
SYM helper/controller motion unknown; PSP donor mapping hypothesis requires gameplay review
Analytical poses prove serialization consistency, not actual game animation correctness
PSP blood/effect and all costume states not validated
Source atlas/material render semantics not fully reproduced; sampled UV appearance only
Not registered in desktop adapters; production SYM remains disabled

render_camera.method: Shared unrendered camera-bound corners; absent from PAC/OBJ
